title: 考研主题练习 01 · 教育与人的成长
description: 原创缩编练习，学习情境为虚构，覆盖非听力题型。参考考研英语一的研究、证据和学术表达章节，全文为原创缩编内容。

sections.title: 写作
sections.instructions: 按题目要求完成写作。提交后查看参考范文，自行核对。
study_paragraphs: Examination results provide useful evidence of preparation, but practical experience should be valued highly in postgraduate education as well. Research requires students to formulate a problem, revise a method and respond when evidence contradicts an expectation. A balanced admission process could combine academic records with a small research proposal, an interview and evidence of sustained work. The criteria should be clear so applicants from different backgrounds can be compared fairly. Valuing practice does not mean lowering standards. It recognises that advanced study requires both knowledge and the ability to use it carefully.

sections.title: 选词填空
sections.instructions: 从词库选词，每词只用一次。
paragraphs: A good research question is not always the most [1] ______ one. It is a question that can be [2] ______ with the time and evidence available. A student may begin with a broad [3] ______, then narrow it after reading earlier studies. This process helps the researcher [4] ______ what can be answered and what must remain uncertain. Clear limits often make a project more [5] ______.
study_paragraphs: A good research question is not always the most ambitious one. It is a question that can be examined with the time and evidence available. A student may begin with a broad interest, then narrow it after reading earlier studies. This process helps the researcher identify what can be answered and what must remain uncertain. Clear limits often make a project more valuable.

questions.explanation: 第 1 空填入 ambitious，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 2 空填入 examined，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 3 空填入 interest，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 4 空填入 identify，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 5 空填入 valuable，结合上下文和句法关系判断。

sections.title: 信息匹配 · 教育与人的成长
sections.instructions: 根据段落内容完成匹配。
paragraphs: [A] A supervisor asked a student to keep a research diary. It recorded successful experiments, method changes and reasons for abandoning an idea.
[B] A seminar began with a failed project. The speaker explained which assumption was wrong and what later work learned. Students asked more questions.
[C] A group shared data after removing personal identifiers. Both groups agreed how data could be reused and how results would be credited.
[D] A student traced an impressive statistic to its original survey and found a different population. She replaced it with a source whose method she could inspect.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The question after the result
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: An experiment supported a student’s favourite explanation. The supervisor asked what other explanation could produce the same result. The student found that the experiment had not separated two causes. She changed the presentation to state evidence for one possibility, not proof of a final answer. Colleagues could then suggest a new test.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The value of a detour
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A graduate student planned to study one archive, but it closed for repairs. An adviser suggested visiting a smaller local collection and interviewing its archivist. The detour revealed letters that changed the student’s understanding. It did not completely replace the original archive, so she revised her question and stated the limitation. The project became more modest but more original.

sections.title: 翻译 · 中译英
sections.instructions: 完成翻译，提交后查看参考译文。
paragraphs: 研究生教育不仅要求学生掌握专业知识，还要求他们能够独立思考、清楚表达并承担研究责任。一个好的研究项目不一定会立即得到确定的答案，但它应该提出有意义的问题，并通过可靠的证据不断修正理解。
study_paragraphs: Postgraduate education requires students not only to master specialised knowledge, but also to think independently, express themselves clearly and take responsibility for their research. A good research project may not produce a definite answer immediately, but it should raise a meaningful question and improve our understanding through reliable evidence.

questions.answer: Postgraduate education requires students not only to master specialised knowledge, but also to think independently, express themselves clearly and take responsibility for their research.
